full_judgment: 19. Since the property has been declared to be abandoned property under the provisions of President's Order 16 of 1972 and the petitioner has failed to show that its inclusion in the official Gazette was without lawful authority the presumption attached under the provision of section 5(2) that publication in the official Gazette is the conclusive evidence that the building is an abandoned property and vested in the Government remained unrebutted.
